name: Keyboard Visualizer
description: Renders a live piano-keyboard visualization on Push 3's screen, sourced from Live's actual sounding notes (after octave/scale transforms) rather than raw pad MIDI. Creates its own writable ALSA port ("Keyboard Viz In") that a Live track's MIDI Out can be routed to from Push's own screen. Display takeover is toggled by holding Shift + Note on the hardware. Runs independent of MIDI intercept — never reads pad Note On/Off from the pad grid. Renders via push-manager's display API (takeover mode).
author: push-hack
